Portrait of a Pokot woman leaning on a staff, from 12 miles north of Marigat, Kenya. She is wearing a hide cloak and a large multicoloured beaded collar around her neck. On her wrist is a gold and silver band, and her ear lobes are stretched and decorated with multiple gold ear rings. Her hair is braided and decorated with bead strings.

Portrait of a Pokot man carrying a head rest under one arm, from 12 miles north of Marigat, Kenya. He is wearing a black cloth robe twisted over one shoulder and a cap with a feather tuft on top of his head. He has a gold wrist band and ivory armlet, ad multiple beaded loop necklaces. In his ear are three white metal studs and he has a metal labret piercing.

Portrait of a Pokot man carrying a head rest under one arm, from 12 miles north of Marigat, Kenya. In his ear are three white metal studs and he has a metal labret piercing.

Portrait of a Pokot woman (she is also responsible for looking after goats) leaning on a staff, from 12 miles north of Marigat, Kenya. She is wearing a hide cloak and a large multicoloured beaded collar around her neck. On her wrist is a gold and silver band, and her ear lobes are stretched and decorated with multiple gold ear rings. Her hair is braided and decorated with bead strings.

Portrait of a Pokot woman leaning on a staff, from 12 miles north of Marigat near Lake Baringo, Kenya. She is wearing a hide cloak and a large multicoloured beaded collar around her neck, with a metal key hanging from a chain. On her wrist is a gold and silver band, and her ear lobes are stretched and decorated with multiple gold ear rings. Her hair is braided and decorated with bead strings. On her chest are scarification marks.
